name: Legendary Duelists: Magical Hero Booster Box [1st Edition]
cleanName: Legendary Duelists Magical Hero Booster Box 1st Edition
extDescription:
The 56-card booster set includes new cards to upgrade Dark Magician decks, as well as reprints of high-demand cards like Apprentice Illusion Magician. Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl fuse for the first time in The Dark Magicians, a new Fusion Monster that allows players to draw a card whenever a Spell or Trap is activated. Many of the set’s Spells and Trap cards feature art of the Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl together.

Each Legendary Duelists: Magical Hero booster box contains 36 packs of 5 random cards.
